title: DFT geometry optimization
action: Perform DFT structural relaxation for the unit cells of graphene, planar C3N, penta-graphene, and penta-CN2 to obtain optimized lattice constants and atomic positions.
description: Ground‑state DFT relaxation of the four 2D materials; the optimized structures are required for all subsequent steps.

title: Harmonic force constants
action: Compute harmonic interatomic force constants (IFCs) using density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT) or finite displacements, employing Quantum ESPRESSO + phonopy.
description: Produces the harmonic IFCs needed for phonon dispersion and the anharmonic calculation.

title: Anharmonic third-order force constants
action: Calculate the anharmonic third‑order interatomic force constants using the finite displacement method (supercells) with the same DFT settings.
description: Produces the third‑order IFCs required for solving the phonon Boltzmann transport equation.

title: Solve phonon BTE and compute lattice thermal conductivity
action: Use ShengBTE (iterative method) to solve the linearized phonon Boltzmann transport equation at 300 K for the four materials and output the room‑temperature lattice thermal conductivity (κ_L) in a JSON file.
description: Extract the 300 K κ_L (iterative solution) for each material and write them into the specified JSON.

title: Extract optimized structural parameters
action: From the relaxed geometries of step 1, extract the lattice constant a, inter‑layer distance h, bond lengths l₁ and l₂, and bond angles θ₁ and θ₂ (where applicable) and save them in a JSON file.
description: Report the final lattice parameters matching Table 1 of the paper.
output_schema: {"graphene": {"a": float, "l1": float}, "planar_C3N": {"a": float, "l1": float, "l2": float}, "penta_graphene": {"a": float, "h": float, "l1": float, "l2": float, "theta1": float, "theta2": float}, "penta_CN2": {"a": float, "h": float, "l1": float, "l2": float, "theta1": float, "theta2": float}}
